name: angular-bootstrap-native
description: A real Angular AOT bootstrap batch: the renderer emits CreateNode for the root view, an attr:ng-version property, a child text node and SetTextContent. This is the batch shape produced by angnative-bundle.js and dispatched through na_dispatchBatch into Host::process_batch_json. The same fixture is run by the TS conformance suite and by the Rust host-ffi pipeline test.
